About us Messify at a glance.

Messify is a Dubai meal-plan and catering company. Its meals are cooked fresh every day in a partner kitchen in International City and delivers breakfast, lunch and dinner together each morning across Dubai Academic City, Dubai Silicon Oasis, International City and Dubai Festival City (DFC), from AED 25.63 a meal. It also caters corporate events, parties, university events and weddings across Dubai, Sharjah, Ajman, Abu Dhabi, Ras Al Khaimah and Umm Al Quwain.

Key facts

What Messify doesDaily meal plans and event catering in Dubai and the UAE.
Where meals are cookedPartner kitchen in International City, Dubai
Meal plan delivery areasDubai International Academic City, Dubai Silicon Oasis, International City and Dubai Festival City (DFC) only
Who it servesStudents, working professionals, office teams and residents
Meal plan options1, 2 or 3 meals a day. Monthly: 26 days of meals to use within 30 days. Weekly: 7 days of meals to use within 9 days.
Meal plan prices1 meal a day weekly: AED 215 (7 meals, AED 30.71 each); 2 meals a day weekly: AED 415 (14 meals, AED 29.64 each); 3 meals a day weekly: AED 610 (21 meals, AED 29.05 each); 1 meal a day monthly: AED 715 (26 meals, AED 27.50 each); 2 meals a day monthly: AED 1,400 (52 meals, AED 26.92 each); 3 meals a day monthly: AED 1,999 (78 meals, AED 25.63 each)
Price per mealAED 25.63 to AED 30.71
Token system1 meal = 1 token. Skip a day and use the token later in your plan. Spend extra tokens to double up.
DeliveryEvery morning. All of the day's meals arrive together in one chilled Messify bag with an ice pack.
MenuChanges every day. Tomorrow's menu is visible in the app the day before; choose your meals by 6 PM for next-morning delivery.
HalalAll meals are 100% halal
VegetarianA vegetarian option every day, for every meal
Food safetyPrepared with gloved hands, blast-chilled after cooking, sealed in kraft bowls, packed cold.
CateringCorporate and office, parties and home events, university events, weddings, buffet setups and bulk catering. Fully customisable menus, quoted by headcount.
Catering areasDubai, Sharjah, Ajman, Abu Dhabi, Ras Al Khaimah and Umm Al Quwain
Google rating4.9 out of 5 on Google reviews
How to orderMessify app (App Store and Google Play) or WhatsApp
Opening hoursEvery day, 8 AM to 11 PM
Contact+971 50 251 3033 (phone and WhatsApp), info@messify.me
